payments_page.paths_notice: This page shows the platform balance: deposits, credits and withdrawal requests. Separate escrow jobs hold funds in contracts; they are not moved to this balance.
payments_page.mainnet_escrow: Separate job with direct TON mainnet settlement · open beta
payments_page.mainnet_notice: In escrow the payer signs funding and acceptance; beneficiaries sign their own claims. GSTD and TON are required. A real mainnet payout still needs verification.
payments_page.start_guide: Start here: AI, node, wallet and payments
payments_page.title: Balance & rewards
payments_page.intro: Claim your node rewards, pay for AI requests and request a GSTD withdrawal to your TON wallet.
payments_page.node_step1: Link your TON address in the node dashboard, then connect the same wallet here and verify your login.
payments_page.node_step2: Rewards appear after funded work is accepted. Move them to your available balance using the button below.
payments_page.node_step3: Spend your balance on requests to other nodes or request a withdrawal to your wallet.
payments_page.node_note: No deposit is required to receive rewards. Being online and serving free requests do not earn rewards.
payments_page.wallet_hint: Balances and rewards belong to the connected wallet. If it is already connected, verify login in your wallet app and refresh the data.
payments_page.error_generic: The action could not be completed. Refresh the data and try again later.
payments_page.available_hint: Spend this on network compute or request a withdrawal.
payments_page.pending_hint: Rewards for accepted funded work. The button moves them to your available balance; it does not send a blockchain transfer.
payments_page.reserved_hint: Funds temporarily held for work in progress or a withdrawal request.
payments_page.promo_hint: A separate usage allowance, not GSTD. It cannot be withdrawn or exchanged for tokens.
payments_page.split: Accepted funded work is split: 85% to the executor, 10% to the protocol and 5% to the reserve.
payments_page.reserve_unavailable: Balance backing is not currently verified. New charges and payouts are paused until verification succeeds.
payments_page.deposit_title: Add GSTD to pay for AI
payments_page.deposit_hint: Use this section to buy compute with GSTD. You do not need a deposit to receive your node rewards.
payments_page.deposit_instruction: Send the canonical GSTD token from your connected wallet to the address below. Then enter the incoming recipient-side Jetton transaction hash. A regular TON transfer does not fund your GSTD balance.
payments_page.address_unavailable: Address temporarily unavailable. Do not send a transfer yet.
payments_page.withdraw_hint: A request reserves the amount from your available balance. The custody wallet owner signs the payout; it is not instant. Your connected wallet is the recipient.
payments_page.withdraw_fee: The platform adds no GSTD fee for claiming rewards or withdrawing. The payout sender pays native TON network costs.
payments_page.operator_hint: This section is for the custody wallet owner. Signing sends the payout to the recipient; check the amount and address first.
payments_page.sign: Sign payout · up to 0.05 TON execution budget
payments_page.awaiting: Waiting for blockchain confirmation. Do not send the payout again.
payments_page.receipt_help: Verify receipt or recover an unsent payout
payments_page.recover: Check reserve recovery · available after 12 minutes

errors.auth_required: Connect the correct TON wallet and verify login in its app, then select Refresh data.
errors.signature_uncertain: The signature was rejected or the send result is unknown. Check your wallet and transaction. Do not send the payout again.
errors.ledger_unavailable: Balance accounting is temporarily unavailable. Try refreshing later.
errors.backing_not_reconciled: Balance backing has not been verified yet. Payouts are unavailable.
errors.withdrawal_not_found: No matching withdrawal request was found for this wallet.
errors.payout_already_prepared_do_not_resend: This payout is already prepared. Check its status and do not send it again.
errors.Wallet mismatch: A different wallet is connected. Use the wallet associated with this action.
errors.invalid_amount: Enter a positive GSTD amount, for example 1.5.
errors.amount_too_large: This amount is too large. Please check it.
errors.insufficient_backing: There is not enough verified backing for this operation. No new charge is made.
errors.ledger_busy: The balance is being updated. Try checking again shortly.
errors.payout_in_flight: A payout is already being processed. Do not send it again.
errors.another_payout_requires_reconciliation: A previous payout needs blockchain reconciliation before another can proceed.
errors.withdrawal_request_cooldown: Wait up to one minute before creating a new withdrawal request. Your balance has not been charged again.

payments_page.withdraw_rate: A new withdrawal request can be created once per minute. Rechecking the same request does not reserve funds again.
payments_page.reject_request: Decline request and return the full reserve
payments_page.operator_declined: The payout operator declined this request before signing. The full amount is available in your balance again.
payments_page.signing_title: Who signs and pays for each action
payments_page.signing_login: Sign-in: you prove wallet ownership. This transfers no funds and requires no TON fee.
payments_page.signing_deposit: Deposit: you send GSTD from your wallet and pay native TON network costs. Review the token, amount and recipient before signing.
payments_page.signing_claim: Move rewards to balance: this updates platform accounting, without an on-chain transfer or TON fee.
payments_page.signing_withdraw: Withdrawal: you request a payout; the custody wallet owner signs the transfer and pays TON. Funds reach your connected wallet after blockchain confirmation.
payments_page.custody_notice: Your paid balance is recorded by the platform. Withdrawal requires the custody wallet owner’s signature: requesting a payout does not send tokens immediately.
payments_page.signature_safety: No seed phrase or private key is ever required. Reject a wallet request if its action, amount or recipient differs from what you expect.
payments_page.withdraw_before_request: The operator can decline a request before transfer preparation and return the full reserve. After transfer preparation, blockchain reconciliation is required.

escrow_lab.title: Batch escrow · TON testnet
escrow_lab.intro: Test one funded batch, one acceptance decision and beneficiary-signed withdrawals. No per-request blockchain transactions.
escrow_lab.test_only: TESTNET ONLY. These tokens have no value. This page does not withdraw platform balances. Actual computation starts only with the separate button after funding and a signed authorization. Mainnet transactions are blocked.
escrow_lab.isolated: This connection is stored separately from your platform wallet. Select TON testnet in your wallet. Never enter a seed phrase or private key.
escrow_lab.wrong_network: Select TON testnet in your wallet, disconnect here and reconnect. Signing is disabled on mainnet.
escrow_lab.restore_review: Draft restored. Review it and prepare again; no transaction was sent.
escrow_lab.demo_recipients: For a single-wallet rehearsal, all recipients initially use your address; the shares are still separate. Change recipient addresses before preparing if testing with another operator. They are immutable after preparation.
escrow_lab.requests: Scenario request count (cost estimate, not measured usage)
escrow_lab.review: Check every recipient and save this draft before funding.
escrow_lab.budget_explanation: The wallet attaches execution budgets; unused amounts can return or be reclaimed. Attached TON is not the actual consumed fee.
escrow_lab.budget_path: Attached budgets for deploy, funding, acceptance and three withdrawals
escrow_lab.not_fee_quote: Test-token minting adds 0.20 testnet TON; optional recovery has its own budget. No additional GSTD claim fee. The wallet shows each transaction; actual network fees vary.
escrow_lab.gas_proof: Sandbox: five separate escrows consumed 0.191947035 TON in fees; one batch consumed 0.038391541 TON, about 5 times less. Includes native reclaim, excludes test-token minting. Not a mainnet quote.
escrow_lab.steps: Check the network, obtain test tokens if needed, deploy and fund the batch. For a node task, sign permission to run and check the result; then accept and withdraw the three shares. On failure, wait until expiry and request a refund.
escrow_lab.check_limits: Chain checks run only on button presses and are globally limited to protect free services. Wait at least 20 seconds between checks. All three shares must confirm funding.
escrow_lab.submitted: Wallet returned a signature. Check chain state; this is not a payment receipt.
escrow_lab.rejected: Wallet request rejected. No automatic retry was made.
escrow_lab.uncertain: Transaction status is uncertain. Inspect your wallet and chain state before retrying.
escrow_lab.pending: An operation is awaiting chain evidence. Sending again is disabled, including after reload when this batch is restored. Use Check chain state; no request is retried automatically. If no state change appears, inspect your wallet transaction before attempting recovery.
escrow_lab.recovery_hint: Resynchronize a delayed decision, retry a funding notification, or reclaim unused native TON to the payer. Each contract retains 0.02 TON for storage. These actions do not change the accepted/refunded decision.

escrow_lab.wallet_storage: Canonical token wallets also retain native TON for their own storage. These balances are not included in the four-contract reserve or in consumed transaction fees.
escrow_lab.invalid_wallet_request: The request was not sent to the wallet: the SDK rejected its format before sending. An explicit retry is available after the format is fixed.
escrow_lab.new_test_batch_hint: If no wallet prompt appeared while minting free tGSTD, you can start a new test batch. The previous batch and pending operation remain archived in this browser; its request is not cancelled. Reject the old request if it appears in your wallet. This is available only for valueless test-token minting before funds are reserved.
escrow_lab.new_test_batch_notice: A new test draft was created. The previous batch remains archived in this browser; nothing was automatically resent. Select “Check batch”, then “Check network state”.
escrow_lab.wallet_signed: The wallet returned a signature; blockchain confirmation is checked separately.
escrow_lab.wallet_delivered: TON Connect confirmed dispatch to the wallet; this does not confirm signing or transfer.
escrow_lab.wallet_not_confirmed: TON Connect has not confirmed dispatch to the wallet. This does not prove the request never arrived.
escrow_lab.wallet_stage_unknown: The dispatch stage was not recorded for this older operation.

wallet_errors.validation: The SDK rejected the request format locally before sending.
wallet_errors.rejected: The wallet reported rejection by the user.
wallet_errors.bad_request: The wallet rejected the request parameters. Retry remains blocked until the chain is checked.
wallet_errors.wallet_unknown: The wallet returned an internal error without confirming a transfer.
wallet_errors.disconnected: The SDK reported that the wallet was disconnected.
wallet_errors.wrong_network: The SDK reported a wallet/transaction network mismatch.
wallet_errors.unsupported: The wallet does not support this operation or message count.
wallet_errors.transport_or_ui: A connection or TON Connect window error occurred. Transaction outcome is unknown; retry remains blocked.

escrow_lab.test_asset_v2: Test asset V2: the name, tGSTD symbol and 9 decimals are stored on-chain under TEP-64.
escrow_lab.test_asset_legacy: Legacy test asset V1: metadata is absent; the original task address is preserved.
escrow_lab.compatible_asset_hint: This empty test batch can be replaced by a new rehearsal using V2, which includes wallet metadata. The previous batch and uncertain operation remain archived in this browser and are not cancelled. This creates a different contract and requires new signatures. Save recovery data first. Reject any old request that appears in the wallet.
escrow_lab.compatible_asset_start: Prepare a new test with asset V2
escrow_lab.compatible_asset_started: The old test remains archived in this browser. A new V2 draft was prepared; no tokens or TON were transferred.
escrow_lab.gas_proof_legacy_asset: This comparison used test asset V1, not V2; costs for the new asset are checked separately.
escrow_lab.test_asset_import: The token need not appear in the wallet list: balances and funding are verified on-chain. Optionally add the master address while staying on TON testnet.
escrow_lab.asset_address_copied: The test tGSTD master address was copied.
escrow_lab.job_intro: Operator-only rehearsal: one exact-model arithmetic task, 85/10/5 settlement in valueless tGSTD. The payer must be the node’s separately signed testnet beneficiary. This does not change mainnet payout settings. All three shares return to this test wallet.
escrow_lab.job_prepared: Task prepared. Deploy, check and fund the escrow before authorizing computation.
escrow_lab.job_run: Sign permission and run funded task
escrow_lab.job_no_ledger: This task settles only through its contract. No internal GSTD balance is credited.
escrow_lab.job_queued: Task queued once. Check the result shortly; no automatic retries.
escrow_lab.job_state_expired: Expired: computation blocked; complete the refund

escrow_mainnet.title: GSTD escrow · TON mainnet
escrow_mainnet.real_funds: REAL GSTD AND TON. Every financial operation is signed in your wallet. Test tokens are not used here.
escrow_mainnet.public_beta: Open beta: anyone can connect a wallet and participate. Nodes appear after registration, wallet linking and advertising an available model. Each task is capped at 1 GSTD. A real mainnet cycle has not yet been verified; users pay TON fees.
escrow_mainnet.pilot: Controlled first release: only the node payout wallet may pay for now. Each task is capped at 1 GSTD. Public access follows a verified real payment and payouts.
escrow_mainnet.manual_acceptance: The payer evaluates the answer and explicitly accepts it. The contract does not judge AI quality or arbitrate disputes; both parties must agree.
escrow_mainnet.wrong_network: Select TON mainnet in your wallet. Financial operations are blocked.
escrow_mainnet.connect_hint: This mainnet connection is separate from testnet and the platform wallet.
escrow_mainnet.rpc_ready: Mainnet reading is configured. A key does not confirm a balance or transfer.
escrow_mainnet.rpc_missing: Mainnet reading is not configured yet. Financial buttons are blocked.
escrow_mainnet.pilot_wallet: For the first release connect the node payout wallet:
escrow_mainnet.choose_model: Choose a model installed on an online node
escrow_mainnet.no_models: No online node offers a paid model. Models are never silently replaced.
escrow_mainnet.consent: I allow sending this request to the selected node. Its model and payment recipient will be fixed for this task.
escrow_mainnet.prepared: Task prepared. Save recovery data and check balances and recipients before signing.
escrow_mainnet.restored: Task restored. Check chain state; no transfers were repeated.
escrow_mainnet.gas: Attached TON budgets: deployment 0.40; funding up to 0.30; acceptance 0.30; each withdrawal 0.08. These are not measured consumed fees. Unused TON can be reclaimed; four escrow contracts retain 0.08 TON in total for storage. Jetton-wallet storage is separate.
escrow_mainnet.privacy: Request and response text is not published on-chain or through the public API. The server record expires one hour after its last change. Private recovery files contain the request, response and their access token: keep them private. A separate payment-details file excludes that data.
escrow_mainnet.run: Sign permission and send request to node
escrow_mainnet.check_limits: Chain state is checked only by button. Wait at least 30 seconds between checks to protect the free RPC.
escrow_mainnet.no_ledger: Settlement uses only this contract. Platform balances are not credited a second time.
escrow_mainnet.recovery_hint: Repeated decision delivery preserves the original decision. TON reclamation leaves required storage reserves. These operations also require your wallet signature.
escrow_mainnet.pending: Awaiting chain reconciliation. Automatic resending is blocked, including after restoring the page.
escrow_mainnet.signed: Wallet returned a signature; chain confirmation is pending.
escrow_mainnet.delivered: Request reached the wallet; signing and payment are not confirmed.
escrow_mainnet.not_confirmed: Wallet request delivery is not confirmed yet.
escrow_mainnet.submitted: Wallet returned a signature. Check chain state.
escrow_mainnet.rejected: You rejected the request. No transfer was repeated.
escrow_mainnet.invalid_request: Wallet rejected request format before sending.
escrow_mainnet.uncertain: Outcome is uncertain. Check your wallet and chain state; resending is blocked.
escrow_mainnet.queued: Task queued once to the selected node. Check the result shortly.

agent_access.title: Agent spending permissions
agent_access.intro: Allow Codex to buy exact-model inference within a budget you approve once.
agent_access.scope: This permission spends only your backed platform balance. It cannot sign TON transactions, withdraw GSTD or access your wallet keys.
agent_access.funding: The limit is an allowance, not a deposit. Each request requires an available backed GSTD balance. Empty or invalid responses are refunded.
agent_access.model: Exact model and current price per request
agent_access.executors: Allow these executors to receive prompts and rewards:
agent_access.terms: By signing you authorize automatic acceptance of a nonempty response from the exact model, with 85% to its executor, 10% to the protocol and 5% to the reserve. The permission allows at most 100 attempts and 256 output tokens per request. Output quality is not guaranteed. Revocation stops new reservations; already reserved jobs may finish.
agent_access.secret: Save this private credential now. It is shown only once. Anyone with this file can spend within the permission. Do not send it in chat or commit it.
agent_access.save: For the Codex installed here, save as gstd-agent-grant.json in the configured private connector folder. See the connector guide for its exact path. Restart is not required after saving.
agent_access.auth_required: Connect your wallet and complete the wallet login, then refresh.
agent_access.wrong_network: Connect the same TON mainnet wallet used for login.
agent_access.invalid_grant_policy: Check the budget, per-request limit, lifetime and executor selection.
agent_access.request_failed: The operation did not finish. Refresh permissions before retrying; do not repeat a wallet signature automatically.

protocol_income.title: Protocol income — 10%
protocol_income.automatic: The protocol share from new accepted paid work is automatically credited to this wallet's available platform balance.
protocol_income.notice: This is a backed platform balance, not a blockchain transfer. Withdrawals use the existing request flow and custody-wallet signature; revenue differs from network turnover.
protocol_income.reserve: The other 5% remains separate for GSTD/XAUt0 liquidity. XAUt0 acquisition and liquidity provision are not yet executed automatically.

node_economics.title: Node economics
node_economics.intro: Operators set their own minimum payment in a USD reference. Buyers pay GSTD using a short-lived quote and explicit spending ceiling.
node_economics.risk: A quote fixes the agreed payment temporarily. It does not guarantee a USD return after receiving GSTD. Account for price changes, demand, idle time, model quality and conversion costs.
node_economics.node: Node owned by your payout wallet
node_economics.net: Minimum executor share per accepted request, USD
node_economics.bytes: Maximum input text size, UTF-8 bytes
node_economics.fixed: This is a fixed price per accepted request within these limits, not metered actual tokens. The network adds protocol and reserve shares using 85/10/5. Empty responses and failed work are not paid.
node_economics.commitment: Issued quotes remain valid for up to 90 seconds; reserved jobs keep their commitments. Disabling an offer stops new paid work for this model. Nodes without a configured offer retain legacy tariffs whose profitability is unverified. Existing free trials are a separate unrewarded mode.
node_economics.assumptions: Enter your own costs. An empty field means unknown, not zero. The editable 25% utilization is an example, not a demand forecast. Desired profit is not included unless you include it in your costs.
node_economics.hourly: All-in node cost per hour, USD
node_economics.utilization: Expected share of time doing paid work, %
node_economics.gross_cost: Buyer price covering this cost at an 85% executor share
node_economics.measure: Run a short network timing sample on my model
node_economics.sample_notice: One measurement including networking and warmup, with a 64-token output budget. It is not a measured operating cost, quality proof or full-workload benchmark.
node_economics.auth_required: Connect the node payout wallet and complete login, then refresh.
node_economics.failed: The operation did not finish. Check wallet ownership, node availability and limits; no funds were charged.
node_economics.estimated_margin: Offer minus estimated costs, before conversion and taxes
node_economics.below_cost: Your selected payment is below your own estimated costs. Adjust the price, utilization or work limits; a positive estimate still does not guarantee realized profit.
node_economics.suggestion: Use an estimated {{tokens}}-token limit from this sample (not a runtime guarantee)

chat_pricing.unavailable: No suitable quote is available. Choose an exact model with a matching operator offer. No funds charged.
chat_pricing.uncertain: If the paid request was already sent, its outcome needs verification. Use Check payment and recover response. Do not create another paid request before checking its receipt.
chat_pricing.receipt_pending: Request state is not yet confirmed. Check the connected wallet and repeat only the receipt lookup; it does not repeat payment.
chat_pricing.receipt_state: Payment state: {{state}}. An expired or deleted response is not recomputed automatically. This lookup does not charge funds.
chat_pricing.regenerate: This creates a new request that may require a new payment. To recover an existing paid answer, check its receipt first. Continue?
